records.title: Partitioning the storage effect and relative nonlinearity in a stochastic consumer-resource model
records.abstract: We derive a stochastic differential equation formulation of a two-consumer one-resource model with environmental stochasticity and show how the invasion growth rate decomposes into storage effect and relative nonlinearity terms. A Fokker-Planck analysis yields closed-form quasi-stationary distributions in the small-noise limit.

When do pairwise niche and fitness differences disagree with structural stability? A multispecies test
records.abstract: Using 120 simulated and 14 empirical plant communities we compare pairwise niche difference and fitness difference metrics with feasibility domain measures of structural stability. Disagreement grows with species richness and with the variance of the interaction matrix.

records.title: Species asynchrony under autocorrelated environmental fluctuations stabilizes ecosystem functioning
records.abstract: We extend diversity-stability theory to autocorrelated environments and show that the portfolio effect weakens as environmental autocorrelation increases, using a stochastic Lotka-Volterra framework and 30 years of grassland data.

records.title: Conspecific negative density dependence and tree species coexistence across ForestGEO plots
Human-wildlife coexistence in peri-urban landscapes: a survey
records.abstract: We survey attitudes toward coyotes in peri-urban neighborhoods and discuss pathways to human-wildlife coexistence.

records.title: Seed dispersal distances of a tropical palm estimated with genetic markers
records.abstract: Dispersal kernels were estimated from parentage analysis; mean dispersal distance was 43 m.

records.title: Invasion graphs and permanence for Lotka-Volterra systems with higher-order interactions
records.abstract: We extend the invasion graph criterion for permanence to Lotka-Volterra systems with higher-order interactions and provide a computable sufficient condition for uniform persistence.

records.title: Coexistence of Wi-Fi and 5G in unlicensed spectrum: a game-theoretic analysis
records.abstract: We model spectrum sharing between Wi-Fi and 5G NR-U as a repeated game.

records.title: Soil nutrient heterogeneity and grassland productivity
records.abstract: Plots with higher spatial heterogeneity in soil nitrogen showed greater species coexistence and slightly higher temporal stability of productivity over eight years.
